name: Checkmk
what_it_is: Checkmk is a comprehensive IT monitoring system for infrastructure and application observability across physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud environments. It provides agent-based and agentless monitoring with 2000+ integrations, auto-discovery, and a web-based UI served via Apache on port 5000.
components: Agent receiver (TCP fetcher, port 6556 on monitored hosts)
protocols: Livestatus (Unix socket and optional TCP port 6557)
measurement: Metric time series stored in RRD files
Predictive levels (ML-based threshold computation via prediction_backend)
Hardware inventory (CPU, memory, disk, network interfaces)
Database metrics (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, DB2, MongoDB, SAP HANA)
Network device metrics via SNMP MIBs
configuration: CMK_SITE_ID env var — OMD site name (default: cmk)
CMK_PASSWORD env var — admin UI password (random if unset)
CMK_LIVESTATUS_TCP env var — set to 'on' to expose Livestatus on TCP port 6557
MAIL_RELAY_HOST env var — SMTP smart host for alert emails
TZ env var — timezone injected into site environment file
DISTRO_CODENAME build arg — Ubuntu codename for .deb package selection
omd config — runtime site configuration (Apache port, Livestatus mode)
fault_injection: omd stop <site> — graceful site shutdown (triggered by SIGTERM/SIGHUP/SIGINT)
HEALTHCHECK: omd status returns non-zero when any site process is down
Broken version symlink at /omd/sites/<id>/version triggers automatic omd update --conflict=install
Missing CMK_SITE_ID causes container to exit with error
Missing .deb package file causes RUN layer to fail with explicit error message
modes: Enterprise (distributed monitoring, LDAP, automated agent management)
Agent-based monitoring (TCP pull agent on port 6556)
Push agent mode (Cloud edition — agent initiates connection)
Special agent mode (vendor APIs: AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, etc.)
Piggyback mode (relay data from proxy hosts)
Active checks mode (ping, HTTP, TCP, DNS, certificates)
constraints: Docker image requires a pre-downloaded .deb package; it cannot pull from the internet during RUN — package must be COPY-ed in before build
Only one OMD site per container is the expected pattern; the site name is fixed at container create time via CMK_SITE_ID
Livestatus TCP (port 6557) is disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled via CMK_LIVESTATUS_TCP=on
The build image (IMAGE_CMK_BASE) is not publicly distributed; building from source requires Checkmk's internal build infrastructure
Distributed monitoring and LDAP integration require Enterprise edition or higher — Raw edition is single-site only
OpenTelemetry application metrics ingestion requires Cloud edition
Push agents and auto-registration of hosts require Cloud edition
OMD site data volume must be mounted to persist configuration across container restarts; re-creation without volume resets all config
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in the repository — Docker usage is single-container via docker run; compose examples exist only in documentation
No built-in time-series database UI (relies on RRD files; Grafana integration is a separate optional add-on)
No native Prometheus scrape endpoint in Raw edition (available via special agent or third-party plugin)
No Kubernetes operator for automated deployment — installation is manual via packages or Docker
